model: ElevenLabs for every voice (narrator + characters). Add a character: audition 3 library voices on one of its lines; the owner picks for major characters.

narrator.name: Rudra – Intense Documentary Narrator (ElevenLabs library; replace after your own audition)
narrator.delivery: eleven_v4 audio tags per line, e.g. [curious], [dramatically], [softly], [intense], [deep voice], [pause]
narrator.processing: light polish only: highpass 45Hz, gentle 2:1 compression, tiny room
narrator.calm_rule: Calm storyteller: only [softly] [warmly] [curious] [serious] [thoughtfully] [pause]; the picker drops takes > f0_hz + f0_max_rise (shouting)
narrator.sloka: USER choice (Nov 21 2026): the narrator Rudra also recites the Sanskrit ślokas, after an audition against Shardul K, Hari Kavi, Sudhir, Shrey and Kanika (cast/audition/sloka/).
narrator.chosen: example only: audition 4-6 narrators and let the owner pick
